subject: Invoice delivery & remittance: preferred channel and VAT evidence
messages:

Cc: tom.ellis@stardrive.com
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery options + VAT/evidence for US and EU entities

Hi Jonas,

We’re finalizing AP onboarding for Stardrive (US entity + EU subsidiary). Can you confirm:

- What invoice delivery channels you support (PDF email, portal push, SFTP/e-invoice webhook, XML e-invoice)?
- Do you provide a monthly consolidated invoice for multi-entity billing? We’d prefer one file per legal entity.
- How do you provide VAT evidence for EU invoices (certificate or XML tags)? We need the format to pass our local filing.

Also, our AP lead is Tom Ellis (tom.ellis@stardrive.com) — please include him in the setup exchange and any test invoice.

Thanks,

Sara Morgan
Head of Finance Operations
Stardrive Analytics
[sara.morgan@stardrive.com]

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Morgan <sara.morgan@stardrive.com>
Cc: tom.ellis@stardrive.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options + VAT/evidence for US and EU entities

Thanks Sara — looping in Marissa (billing ops) and Laura (payments) to coordinate. Quick answers up front, then proposed next steps below.

Supported delivery channels:
- PDF by email: one-off or CC to billing inbox (good for small customers).
- Portal push (preferred for higher volume): we post PDF + link in your AP portal and email a delivery notice.
- SFTP / secure webhook: we can push XML or PDF files nightly to an SFTP endpoint or via a signed webhook.
- XML e-invoice: we support a simple XML schema for structured invoices; attached is the schema (invoice_xml_schema.xsd).

VAT evidence:
- For EU entities we can include VAT IDs and VAT breakdown lines in the XML schema and embed a VAT-evidence PDF (certificate) in the portal bundle.
- If you need a signed VAT certificate file, we can attach that to the monthly package.

Consolidation & entity separation:
- We can generate one consolidated PDF per legal entity per month (preferred). We do not mix invoices for different legal entities in the same file unless you explicitly request a combined master.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Tom to confirm preferred channel for each entity (email PDF only vs portal + email notice vs SFTP push).
2) If SFTP/webhook: provide endpoint, SSH fingerprint, and preferred file naming convention.
3) We’ll send a sample test invoice (PDF + XML) for your AP to ingest and confirm mapping.
4) Confirm remittance instructions and whether you require a PO on invoice.

I attached a short checklist and the XML schema. Marissa will coordinate the test invoice this week.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Director, GTM Finance (Redwood Inference)
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-invoice-onboarding-checklist.pdf, invoice_xml_schema.xsd

Jonas / Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. For Stardrive:

- US entity: portal push + email copy to billing@stardrive.com (we want the PDF for AP inbox and the portal record).
- EU subsidiary: SFTP nightly push with XML + PDF bundle (our local AP system parses XML).
- Consolidation: one file per legal entity, monthly.
- VAT evidence: include VAT ID in XML and attach the VAT certificate PDF in the bundle. That should be sufficient for local filing.

SFTP details (test env):
host: sftp.stardrive-inbound.com
user: rdw_stardrive_test
SSH fp: SHA256:AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz0123456789+==
preferred filename pattern: stardrive_{entity}_{yyyymmdd}.zip

We do not require a PO on Redwood invoices; we’ll route to our finance system based on the account code in the XML.

Please send a test packet to the test SFTP and an email copy to billing@stardrive.com.
